diagnosis: Candidate/bad runs overproduce repeated, non-progress operations, especially repeated clicks, no-ops, and scrolling.
expected_mechanism: Detecting recurrence and requiring a changed strategy prevents unproductive loops. The cost is extra state checking and deliberation before retrying, plus occasional interruption of a valid transient-error retry.
policy_text: Before repeating an action toward the same objective, compare it with recent actions and observed state. If the prior attempt produced no meaningful state change, do not retry unchanged; inspect the state, alter the method or target, or stop with a concise blocker. Permit unchanged retries only for explicit transient failures.

quantitative_evidence.command: jq -r '[if .value>0 then "bad" else "good" end, (.stack_frames[0]=="result:repeated"), ((.value|abs)|tostring)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\t' '{tot[$1]+=$3;if($2=="true")rep[$1]+=$3} END{for(s in tot)printf "%s repeated=%d total=%d rate=%.2f%%\n",s,rep[s],tot[s],100*rep[s]/tot[s]}'
quantitative_evidence.finding: Bad runs contain 1,485 repeated operations among 7,366 total (20.16%); good runs contain 224 among 3,780 (5.93%). The bad-side rate is 3.40× higher, with a signed excess of 1,261 operations.

quantitative_evidence.command: jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]=="result:repeated") | [.stack_frames[2],(.value|tostring)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\t' '{if($2>0)p[$1]+=$2;else n[$1]+=-$2} END{for(k in p)printf "%s\tbad=%d\tgood=%d\texcess=%d\n",k,p[k],n[k],p[k]-n[k]}' | sort -t= -k4,4nr
quantitative_evidence.finding: The largest repeated-action excesses are clicks: 679 bad versus 40 good (+639); no-ops: 441 versus 85 (+356); and scrolls: 278 versus 1 (+277).

quantitative_evidence.command: jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]=="result:repeated") | [(.value|if .>0 then "bad" else "good" end), .labels.source_session[0], ((.value|abs)|tostring)] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\t' '{sum[$1]+=$3;seen[$1 SUBSEP $2]=1} END{for(s in sum){n=0;for(k in seen){split(k,a,SUBSEP);if(a[1]==s)n++}printf "%s repeated_ops=%d sessions=%d\n",s,sum[s],n}}'
quantitative_evidence.finding: Repeated operations occur across 88 bad source sessions but only 20 good source sessions, confirming recurrence across runs rather than concentration in one trace.
